description: Values that fill a {param} of a route path. The CLI and shared client, the UI and MCP refuse each 'refused' value, and accept each 'accepted' value. TestExtensionToolsShould checks each list against ExtensionPaths, so the client copies of the rule cannot drift from Hub. 'encodedNever' lists the ExtensionPaths.FORBIDDEN parts that no encoded value can contain, such as a raw ; of a matrix parameter: each other part must be in a 'refused' value, raw or encoded.
